dict.string: Oyl reads the current song from Music and Spotify and controls playback, and asks your browser which tabs an agent (Muse, ChatGPT…) is working in, to show it at work.
Oyl listens to Music and Spotify's audio so the visualizer moves with the song.
Oyl watches for hand gestures while your pointer is over the open notch.
Oyl keeps your latest screenshots, and what you've saved there from Messages and elsewhere, on its shelves, to drag into other apps, and saves files it converts beside the originals.
Oyl saves files it converts beside the originals.
Oyl's Recently Saved shelf shows what you've just saved to Downloads, to drag into other apps, and Oyl saves files it converts beside the originals.

Oyl's phone remote lets your phone, on the same Wi-Fi, show your agents, answer their requests, and work the music, timers and keep-awake. It's off until you turn it on, and only answers phones you've paired.
While Wispr Flow takes down what you say, Oyl shows your voice in the notch. It only listens then, and keeps nothing.
Oyl's Recently Saved shelf shows the photos and videos you've saved from Messages and other apps, to drag into other apps.
